subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make OpenAI-compatible HTTP requests ignore a generic request body `model`, or should the body `model` remain a validated OpenClaw agent-target field even when the header selects an agent?
rationale: The source fix is narrow, but it changes a public API precedence contract that is currently documented as agent-first and shared by sibling gateway endpoints.

options.title: Agent header wins
options.body: Treat the body `model` as SDK compatibility filler when a valid agent header is present, and use `x-openclaw-model` as the only backend-model override surface.

options.title: Keep current validation
options.body: Continue requiring the body `model` to be omitted or use an OpenClaw agent target even when `x-openclaw-agent-id` is present, and document that more explicitly.

options.title: Add explicit compatibility mode
options.body: Preserve current default behavior and add a documented opt-in path for SDKs that must send generic OpenAI model ids with agent headers.

recommendation.title: Agent header wins
recommendation.body: Treat the body `model` as SDK compatibility filler when a valid agent header is present, and use `x-openclaw-model` as the only backend-model override surface.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current agent-first contract and reviewed the adjacent selector-validation fix, making him the best available owner for this API-precedence call.
